description.value: Beacon Landing Liquor and More is a full-service liquor retailer on Beacon Avenue in Sidney, offering beer, wine, and spirits for in-store pickup or local delivery. The shop runs a rewards program and regular tastings, and its central location on Sidney's main commercial strip makes it a convenient resupply point for cyclists passing through the Saanich Peninsula.
